findings.summary: The prepare/apply flow binds evaluator output to the frozen task revision, evaluated SHA, blueprint digest, and evidence digests; mutation-shaped result fields are rejected before quality state can change.
findings.broken_invariant: Quality state may only accept a review bound to an unchanged, read-only implementation target.

recovery_context: Hosted full-fast CI remains the integration gate. The local full-fast run had runner-supervision EPERM and timing failures outside the changed evaluator paths; focused evaluator tests, critical CLI, schemas, lifecycle invariants, typecheck, Knip, and CLI-reference checks passed.
